correctness.rationale: Fourier characters are permuted injectively by A^n; the map between opposite analytic Fourier weights is a weighted permutation, so the operator norm is theta^{min_{k!=0}(|k|_1+|A^n k|_1)}. Unimodular recentering A^r produces positive Fibonacci matrices; explicit sign-case bounds prove F_{n+3} and exactly the four listed Fourier minimizers for each even and odd n, including 0 and 1. Independent exact-integer exhaustive lattice-diamond computation for n=0..10 reproduced the claimed F_{n+3} minimum and four modes every time; beyond that the sign-case proof, not finite tests, carries the quantifier. The norm applies only to specified theta weights and mean-zero observables.
